correctness.rationale: For D generated by complements of independent triples, the Alexander dual L consists exactly of vertex sets with independence number <=2; combinatorial Alexander duality sends H_{mn-6}(D;Z) to H^3(L;Z). The separated four-cycle joins are integral 3-cycles. Each distinguished tetrahedron is maximal in L, giving a cocycle; their pairings form an identity matrix, proving a split free summand. Count of gap pairs is binom(n-2,2). N-6 is below pure N-4 top dimension, obstructing shellability. Independent m=3,n=4 enumeration confirmed all four key tetrahedra maximal.
